intended_behavior: A signature with negative age is rejected with SignatureExpired when max_age is supplied.
weak_test: Omitting max_age bypasses the age check; an exact payload assertion is valid but does not discriminate the negative-age defect.
skipped_test: Method or class skip registers a subject without running the test body.
expected_failure_test: Non-strict xfail suppresses the regression assertion failure; failure detection is not a failing verification command.
claim_boundary: Curated native discrimination evidence, not blind adjudication, mutation adequacy, current RIPR output or support promotion.
